title: Transition Supplies and Utilisation Controls on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Plan
content:
A member new to a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan who is already taking a drug that is not on the formulary, or that the formulary restricts, is given a one-time transition supply so that therapy is never interrupted while a coverage determination is sought.

## The transition supply

The transition supply is of the transition days supply written for the plan held, and may be given the transition fill count of that plan of times inside the member's first ninety days. A member in a long-term care setting may have the supply repeated for as long as the transition period lasts. Where the member has already used every transition fill the plan tells them so plainly and helps them file an exception, rather than letting them find out at the counter.

## The controls, and where they bite

1. Prior authorisation, step therapy and quantity limits apply only on the formulary tiers the plan held lists, and a drug on a tier the plan does not restrict is never held up at the counter for one of these reasons.
2. A refill is refused as too soon until the member has used the threshold percentage of the previous days supply written for the plan held, except where the member is travelling, has lost the medicine, or the prescriber has changed the dose.
3. The opioid safety edit fires at the daily morphine milligram equivalent threshold of the plan held and is a conversation with the prescriber rather than a refusal: the pharmacist may dispense once the prescriber confirms the dose is intended.

| The circumstance put to the desk | Whether the refill is still refused as too soon |
| --- | --- |
| The member has used less than the plan's threshold percentage of the previous days supply, and none of the three circumstances applies | refused |
| The member is travelling | not refused |
| The member has lost the medicine | not refused |
| The prescriber has changed the dose | not refused |

## Medication therapy management

Medication therapy management is offered where the member takes at least the maintenance drug count of the plan held and their annual drug cost passes that plan's threshold; it is an offer, never a condition of coverage.
